description:
An open-source, accessible, blazing fast Mastodon client.

Fedra is a lightweight, fast, and accessible Mastodon client for Windows. It is designed to be completely usable with screen readers and keyboard navigation, providing a seamless social media experience without the bloat.
- A follow request is now answered with Accept, Reject, and Cancel buttons.
- A settings file Fedra can't read is now backed up instead of overwritten, and settings are saved so that a crash can't leave them half-written.
- Added a Remove from List option to the user actions menu.
- Added spell checking to the post, content warning, poll option, and media description boxes on Windows. Misspelled words are underlined, right-clicking one offers suggestions, Add to Dictionary, and Ignore, and F7 moves to the next one. The General options let you turn it off, have misspellings spoken as you type, and choose the spelling language.
- Added the {{ favorited }}, {{ boosted }}, {{ bookmarked }}, and {{ pinned }} template variables.
- Closing the media player or image viewer now stops its download, and saving media shows its progress.
- Confirmations before deleting, removing, or blocking now use Fedra's own Yes and No buttons.
- Dialog buttons now follow your platform's order.
- Fedra is faster with long timelines.
- Fedra now identifies itself fully to servers, so instances behind firewalls such as Prot.li no longer turn it away.
- Fedra now saves your settings and reading position before installing an update, and comes to the front when it restarts.
- Fixed a crash when your lists refreshed while you were editing or deleting one.
- Fixed attached media being dropped when you clicked Done in Manage Media, and over-long media descriptions getting past the limit.
- Fixed copied text vanishing from the clipboard when Fedra exits.
- Fixed deleted posts staying in timelines other than the one that reported them.
- Fixed Edit and Delete appearing in the wrong place in the Post menu.
- Fixed Find matching a post's formatting instead of the text you read, and not wrapping correctly.
- Fixed hashtag timelines loading twice when opened.
- Fixed line breaks in posts being collapsed.
- Fixed loading a draft overwriting its media descriptions and poll options.
- Fixed new posts appearing above pinned posts when refreshing a user timeline.
- Fixed rebinding Previous Account and Next Account leaving Ctrl+[ and Ctrl+] switching accounts as well.
- Fixed streams of closed timelines continuing to run, and streams reconnecting ever more slowly after a dropped connection.
- Fixed text in posts being treated as formatting in the post details view.
- Fixed the draft being lost when a reply failed to send.
- Fixed the instance timeline prompt not closing properly.
- Fixed Toggle Follow failures, and failed actions on posts from other instances, going unreported.
- Media descriptions can now be several lines long, and the media dialog shows how many characters are left.
- Notifications, notification sounds, and new posts now arrive while a dialog such as compose is open, instead of when it closes.
- On macOS, Fedra no longer shows a menu bar icon. Click Fedra in the Dock to bring its window back.
- Pressing Enter in the schedule dialog's time field now sets the schedule.
- Refreshing a timeline no longer moves the selected post.
